modelMcpAggregateMember.description:
One member MCP server of an mcp-aggregate application. Alias namespaces the
member's tools as "<Alias>__<tool>" in the merged catalog.

modelMcpAggregateMembers.description:
Wrapper so the field is a named type with MarshalCQL, as a bare repeated
field reaches gocql as []McpAggregateMember and has no blob encoding.

modelMcpAppConfig.Members.description:
Set only on AppType "mcp-aggregate"; Backends/AuthMode/ResourceOAuth are
unused there, and the members carry their own backend config.
